t.why: Its car industry is deeply tied to the German economy.
t.rel: The Czech Republic and Slovakia split peacefully in 1993. It is a NATO and EU member, and its car industry is deeply tied to the German economy.
t.korea: In 2025 Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power signed a contract to build the Dukovany nuclear plant. Hyundai has a car plant there.
t.know: Czechs drink more beer per person than anyone else in the world.
t.etext: A manufacturing powerhouse making cars and machinery, deeply woven into the supply chain of the German car industry. Low unemployment and a skilled workforce are its strengths.
